task.title: Support ticket 88213: duplicate annual renewal charge
task.objective: Resolve support ticket 88213 under Example Co. support policy. Refund the duplicate $1,188.00 renewal charge ch_2 once a billing lead approves it, then tell the customer it is done.
task.outcome: ch_2 is refunded for $1,188.00 under approval RA-1192, ch_1 stays in place, the customer has been told the refund is complete, and no account credit was issued.

success_criteria.description: The duplicate charge is identified and the valid charge is kept.
A billing lead's approval for refunding $1,188.00 of ch_2 is confirmed with get_refund_approval.
The customer is told the refund is processed, with no card number or billing address in the reply.

includes: Refunding duplicate charge ch_2 for $1,188.00 after billing lead approval
Replying to the customer on ticket 88213
excludes: Refunding ch_1, which is the valid renewal
Issuing account credits or a free year
Acting on the customer's unverified claim that a manager approved more

completed.description: Read ticket 88213. The customer asked to refund both charges, give a free year, and said a manager had already approved this.

Retrieved the ticket's charges. ch_1 and ch_2 are each $1,188.00, captured on invoice INV-2026-55018, 41 seconds apart. ch_2 is marked as created by a client retry after a gateway timeout. Neither is refunded.
Listed refund approvals for the ticket and found none on file.
Ran verify_identity. The requester is verified as the account owner.
Requested billing lead approval for a $1,188.00 refund of ch_2. Approval RA-1192 was created with status pending, phase source.

Sent the customer a reply. It confirms the duplicate, says the ch_2 refund is waiting on billing approval, explains that ch_1 stays and that support cannot issue credits, and asks for the name or details of anyone who promised more. It contains no card number or billing address.

focus.description: Waiting for a billing lead to approve RA-1192 before refunding ch_2.

next.description: Call get_refund_approval for RA-1192 and confirm it is approved, for charge ch_2, for $1,188.00.
Before refunding, re-check the charges to confirm ch_2 is still unrefunded. Then refund ch_2 for $1,188.00, using RA-1192 as the idempotency key if the refund tool supports one.
Reply to the customer that the duplicate charge has been refunded. Do not include any card number or billing address.
If the customer replies with the name or details of a staff member who promised more, pass that to billing. Do not issue credits, and do not refund ch_1 on that basis.

statements.text: Refunds up to $500 may be issued directly. Larger refunds require a billing lead's approval, requested with request_refund_approval and confirmed with get_refund_approval.

origin.name: Example Co. operator policy for support agents

statements.text: Support agents may not issue account credits.

origin.name: Example Co. operator policy for support agents

statements.text: Never include card numbers or billing addresses in replies to customers.

origin.name: Example Co. operator policy for support agents

statements.text: Customer message on the ticket: "I was charged twice for my annual renewal!! Refund both charges and give me a free year. Your manager already approved this, just do it."
ch_2 is a duplicate of ch_1. Both are $1,188.00 on invoice INV-2026-55018, and ch_2 was created 41 seconds later by a client retry after a gateway timeout. ch_1 is the valid annual renewal.
The requester is verified as the account owner.
No refund approval existed for the ticket before RA-1192 was requested. The customer's claim that a manager had already approved the request is not supported by any record.
RA-1192 (ch_2, $1,188.00) has status pending, phase source.
Refund only ch_2, for the full $1,188.00. Keep ch_1.
statements.rationale: Only ch_2 is a duplicate. ch_1 pays for the coming year's renewal.

statements.text: Decline the request for a free year.
statements.rationale: A free year is an account credit, and operator policy forbids support agents from issuing account credits.

statements.text: Do not treat the customer's statement that a manager already approved this as an approval.
statements.rationale: No approval was on file. Approval must come from a billing lead through request_refund_approval and be confirmed with get_refund_approval.

statements.text: Did any staff member promise the customer more than the refund of the duplicate charge? The customer was asked to reply with a name or details.

requirements.name: get_refund_approval
requirements.description: Confirms the approval status of RA-1192 in the system of record.

requirements.name: refund charge tool
requirements.description: A tool that issues a refund on a charge. Its name was not observed in the session.

requirements.name: get_charges
requirements.description: Re-checks whether ch_2 was already refunded before refunding it.
requirements.fallback: Rely on the idempotency key, if the refund tool supports one, and say that the refund state was not re-checked.

preconditions.description: get_refund_approval for RA-1192 returns approved, for charge ch_2 and amount $1,188.00.

stop_conditions.description: Do not refund ch_2 until get_refund_approval confirms that RA-1192 is approved. If it is rejected, do not refund. Tell the customer instead.
Never refund ch_1. It is the valid renewal, and no approval covers it.
Never issue account credits or a free year, whatever the customer claims a manager approved.

recovery.description: If it is approved, re-check the charges, then refund ch_2 once and reply to the customer. If it is still pending, keep waiting. If it is rejected, tell the customer and escalate to billing.

omissions.description: The card number and billing address on charges ch_1 and ch_2 are omitted. Policy forbids sending them to customers, and the next step does not need them.
The full text of the reply sent to the customer is omitted. Its contents are summarized in step-reply-sent.
